snippet.title: ‼️ Release Date Announcement ‼️
snippet.description:
‼️ ANNOUNCEMENT ‼️

Brew & Bastards will be releasing on Steam, Xbox Series S/X and Windows PC on September 22nd 🍻🎉🎉🍻

In development for almost 5 years, we're so excited for everyone to finally get their hands on our juicy dungeon crawler

Wishlist 👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/2556240/Brews__Bastards/Wishlist
